title: Add booking system and service area display for Llano and Burnet counties

requirements.text: Create a booking system component that allows customers to schedule cleaning services online, including fields for customer name, contact information, preferred service type (residential, commercial, car detailing, carpet cleaning), preferred date and time, and service address
acceptanceCriteria: Booking form includes fields for name, email, phone, service type selection, date, time, and address
Form validates all required fields before submission
Successful bookings are stored in the backend
User receives confirmation message after successful booking submission

requirements.text: Add backend data model and functions to store and retrieve booking information including customer details, service type, preferred date and time, and service address
acceptanceCriteria: Backend defines a Booking record type with all necessary fields
Backend provides a function to submit new bookings
Backend provides functions to retrieve bookings by ID and list all bookings
Bookings are persisted in stable storage

requirements.text: Display service area information prominently on the website showing that services are available in Llano and Burnet counties

quotes: service area is llano and burnet county's

acceptanceCriteria: Service area information is visible on the homepage or a dedicated section
Display clearly states coverage of Llano County and Burnet County
Service area information is styled consistently with the existing visual theme

requirements.text: Add navigation link and section for the booking system so customers can easily find and access the online booking form
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation component includes a link to the booking section
Link scrolls smoothly to the booking form when clicked
Booking section is integrated into the main App.tsx component flow

constraints: Use the existing backend actor pattern in backend/main.mo with Map for storage
Follow the existing ContactForm component pattern for building the booking form
Use the existing OKLCH color system and visual theme
